verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a payroll and finance SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a Gusto feature that lets a user set up automations that run on their own. The webhooks, MCP server, CLI and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks for constructing automation, not a first-party background automation capability. The CLI's skill install command is an agent add-on, not a recurring background job.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
